name: Tab-to-Task
description: Save a webpage, remember why it matters, and return to it when you're ready to act.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; connect-src 'none'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

action.default_title: Save this page as a task

_execute_action.description: Save the current page as a task
